facts.text: Para-Lane's authors call real recordings "indispensable" because synthetic scenes lack real sensor noise, whereas forestry researchers call exact twins "insufficient" and argue that statistically matched cousins scale better.
facts.quote: Para-Lane's authors call real recordings "indispensable" because synthetic scenes lack real sensor noise; forestry researchers call exact twins "insufficient" and argue statistically matched cousins scale better.

facts.text: Neither the real-replica position nor the statistically matched cousin position proves that procedural diversity captures every real long-tail case; real replicas preserve correlations and unknown clutter that generators cannot invent.
facts.quote: Neither proves that procedural diversity captures every real long tail, and real replicas preserve correlations and unknown clutter that generators cannot invent.

facts.text: The physics-first realism position wants measured BRDF, dielectric and soil parameters, whereas the data-driven realism position considers a learned sensor model sufficient if it reproduces the observed output distribution.
facts.quote: A physics-first position wants measured BRDF, dielectric and soil parameters; a data-driven position argues that a learned sensor model reproducing the observed output distribution is sufficient.

facts.text: In the physical-versus-learned realism debate, learned sensor models are effective near the training distribution, whereas physical models are easier to reason about when geometry and materials change substantially; the cited extrapolation failures show that neither approach has an unconditional advantage.
facts.quote: The learned approach is effective near the training distribution; the physical approach is easier to reason about when geometry and materials change substantially. The extrapolation failures above show why neither has an unconditional advantage.

facts.text: Industry teams favour 3DGS for editability, as reported in Para-Lane (2025), whereas the XLD results show that the NeRF-based EmerNeRF and UC-NeRF held up better than the 3DGS variant PVG at 4 m offsets.
facts.quote: Industry teams favour 3DGS for editability (Para-Lane, 2025), yet in XLD the NeRF-based EmerNeRF and UC-NeRF held up better than the 3DGS variant PVG at 4 m offsets.

facts.text: Proponents present generative world models for validation as "data machines," exemplified by a DriveDreamer4D-style claim, whereas benchmark results of 13.19 to 20.82 dB PSNR suggest that these models are not yet metric-faithful.
facts.quote: Proponents present them as "data machines" (a DriveDreamer4D-style claim); the benchmark numbers (13.19 to 20.82 dB PSNR) suggest they are not yet metric-faithful.

facts.text: Photorealism may matter as a fidelity metric for camera perception, whereas photorealism is almost irrelevant for radar, braking dynamics and ultrasonic sensing; fidelity should therefore be decomposed by the tested requirement rather than ranked by how convincing screenshots look.
facts.quote: For camera perception it may matter; for radar, braking dynamics and ultrasonic sensing it is almost irrelevant, so fidelity should be decomposed by the tested requirement rather than ranked by how convincing screenshots look.

facts.text: NIST provides strong general evidence that covering arrays shrink configuration spaces while retaining interaction coverage, but safety engineers should not infer that low-order combinations are automatically sufficient for off-road collision avoidance.
